title: Integration test for hub.get() RBAC+intent flow
objective: hub.get() has RBAC + intent logic but no dedicated integration test of the full flow (auth check -> storage lookup -> audit trail).
acceptance_criteria: an integration test verifies get() auth -> lookup -> audit end to end
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
resolution: Added prompt-hub/tests/test_get_rbac.rs (6 tests) covering the full get() flow end to end against a :memory: hub, NO source change (test-only): (1) get() denies a caller without Read (HubError::Unauthorized, checked before any search); (2) get_by_id() denies a caller without Read; (3) get_by_id() returns the exact registered prompt for an authorized caller (auth -> storage lookup); (4) get_by_id() returns Ok(None) for an unknown id; (5) get() finds the registered Developer prompt by role+intent search (auth -> intent lookup); (6) registration writes a queryable audit trail (audit_trail(id).total >= 1) — the create->audit->retrieve loop. Gates: cargo test -p prompt-hub --test test_get_rbac => 6 passed (--all-features AND default features); clippy --all-features --all-targets -D warnings clean; cargo fmt --check clean; default-features library build (CI default-build gate) green. Done via worktree loop/phtask-0039-get-rbac-test.
